entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina, Estela and I sat in Palas Rez..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina, Estela and I sat in Palas Rezna's most ornate stateroom, awaiting the arrival of Queen Beatrice Livingston.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Announcing Her Excellency Beatrice..."
entries.dialogueText: "Announcing Her Excellency Beatrice Livingston, Queen of the Four Corners of Merkopa, Defender of Castle Tzarsbough, Conqueror of the Tranquil Sea, Stout Protector of the Ancient Lands of Rum, Descendant of the Most Honorable King Edward the First and the Ruler of Rumburg.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel came in through the stateroom..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel came in through the stateroom door. He took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stepped aside and Queen Beatrice..."
entries.dialogueText: He stepped aside and Queen Beatrice entered. She was wearing an emerald-green gown that matched her tiara.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina, Estela and I rose to greet th..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina, Estela and I rose to greet the queen.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kissed my sister-in-law on the ch..."
entries.dialogueText: I kissed my sister-in-law on the cheek. She returned the gesture warmly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took my sister-in-law's hand and..."
entries.dialogueText: I took my sister-in-law's hand and kissed it. She looked me up and down.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I shook my sister-in-law's hand. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: I shook my sister-in-law's hand. She returned it with a firm grip.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gave my sister-in-law a hug. She..."
entries.dialogueText: I gave my sister-in-law a hug. She returned it warmly.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""What a pleasure it is to see you,..."
entries.dialogueText: "What a pleasure it is to see you, Your Majesty. We barely had the chance to speak at the coronation."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And my dear niece!""
entries.dialogueText: "And my dear niece!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned towards Vina."
entries.dialogueText: She turned towards Vina.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Why, you're looking more and more..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, you're looking more and more like your mother every day. I hope your father's proud of the lady you've become."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice embraced her tightly befor..."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice embraced her tightly before moving on to my mother.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Queen Beatrice.""
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Beatrice."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Queen Mother Estela.""
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Mother Estela."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She tilted her face upwards and gav..."
entries.dialogueText: She tilted her face upwards and gave a short sniff.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The palace looks as magnificent as..."
entries.dialogueText: "The palace looks as magnificent as always, but I fear a chat with your housekeeper may be in order. Every time I visit, it smells just the faintest bit like trash."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Funny, I do seem to detect an unpl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Funny, I do seem to detect an unpleasant draft of hot air. But only since you walked in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's be civil, ladies. We have im..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's be civil, ladies. We have important state issues to discuss."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shall we be seated?""
entries.dialogueText: "Shall we be seated?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pabel, please look into these matt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pabel, please look into these matters at once. The air quality in the palace may be compromised."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel bemusedly raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel bemusedly raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Right away, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Then I shall take my leave. I have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I shall take my leave. I have a terribly urgent appointment on the other side of the palace."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If you'll excuse me, I shall take..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, I shall take my leave. I have a terribly urgent appointment on the other side of the palace."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""By all means, Your Highness. Our c..."
entries.dialogueText: "By all means, Your Highness. Our chatter is far more boring than the sort of carousing you're used to."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Vina, why don't you run along as w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, why don't you run along as well? We'll catch up over supper."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina reluctantly nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Vina reluctantly nodded.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Sure, Aunt Bea. Have the staff giv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, Aunt Bea. Have the staff give my room a ring when you're done."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He filled two porcelain cups for us..."
entries.dialogueText: He filled two porcelain cups for us, then escorted Vina and my mother out the door.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Queen Mother Estela may have a com..."
entries.dialogueText: "Queen Mother Estela may have a common upbringing, but she's part of the royal family. Please respect her as such."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Whatever do you mean, my love?""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever do you mean, my love?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How is your own family?""
entries.dialogueText: "How is your own family?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To what do we owe this pleasure, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "To what do we owe this pleasure, Your Excellency?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took a sip of Rumburgian tea. Len..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a sip of Rumburgian tea. Lena had loved its earthy taste, but I never quite got used to it.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""First things first.""
entries.dialogueText: "First things first."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Splendid. King Consort Boris sends..."
entries.dialogueText: "Splendid. King Consort Boris sends his sincerest regrets. He had to oversee some air force exercises."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Of course we are the same age, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course we are the same age, Your Majesty, but I've worn my crown for many years longer than you have yours."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And I and my country are far more..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I and my country are far more experienced at dealing with the Republic of Wehlen and their backers in the CSP."

entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. You made a wise arrangement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was joking. They're cousins, for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was joking. They're cousins, for Dast's sake."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: She nodded.

entries.dialogueText: "I feel obliged to ask once more: Are you positive you'll be able to deliver on Rizia's end of the bargain?"
